messages:
Marta (People Ops): Heads-up — new mandatory Privacy micro‑training is live for everyone who handles customer data. Completion required by Apr 10. :calendar:
Marta (People Ops): It’s a short 15‑minute module + 5 question quiz. LMS will auto-issue a cert on pass. Link + evidence steps here: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PEOPLE/pages/Privacy+Microtraining
Lina (People Ops): Why this now? updated data-retention policy goes into effect Apr 15, and we need training evidence for our Q2 compliance review and ISO renewal.
Jordan (Security): Please note: for SOC2 evidence we’ll need team-level completion exports (CSV) and a signed attestation from each manager. Security will pull the CSVs on Apr 11.
Sofia (Legal): Also remind folks about the updated DSPA clause — the microtraining includes a short summary. If anyone has customer-contract concerns, ping me directly.
Ravi (Eng): Quick Q: can contractors take it? Our vendors team has a separate list.
Marta (People Ops): Yes — contractors on payroll/vendor list must complete. If you manage contractors, upload a consolidated CSV to the Confluence page under "Uploads".
Tom (Eng Manager): Can we get manager reports earlier? some of my team will be traveling next week.
Jordan (Security): We can run an early export on Apr 7 if enough teams request it. Reply here with team names by Apr 2.
Ravi (Eng): Got it — adding my team. Thanks.
Lina (People Ops): How to complete: 1) Open LMS link in the Confluence page. 2) Complete module + quiz. 3) Cert auto-posts to your Okta learning profile. 4) If not auto-posted, download PDF and drag to the Confluence "Uploads" section or email people-ops@redwood.com with subject: "Privacy cert - <team> - <name>".
Marta (People Ops): Example subject for manual upload: "Privacy cert - Search Infra - Ravi Kumar"
deploy-bot: Reminder set for Apr 2 09:00 UTC — "Manager list for early export due"
Tom (Eng Manager): Will do. Also can we get a short deck to show the team during standup?
Marta (People Ops): Yes — I’ll post a 2‑slide deck and a 30s script in the Confluence page in ~30 min.
Sofia (Legal): One more thing: completion counts toward the annual attestation. If you already completed last year, the micro-course still needs to be done because the policy changed.
Ravi (Eng): Appreciate the heads-up. How strict is the quiz pass rate?
Jordan (Security): Passing threshold is 80%. Retakes allowed.
Tom (Eng Manager): Thanks — I’ll circulate and add a calendar reminder for my team. :thumbsup:
Marta (People Ops): Thanks everyone — we’ll follow up with targeted nudges to folks with missing certs after Apr 5. If you need an extension for a specific person, DM me and cc your manager. :raised_hands:
